answer.reason: The verses only list Amram in Levite genealogies, giving his parentage, his wife, his children and his age, all of which the summary already records, and they report no deed or event of his own.
doubts: EXO 6:20 says Amram took Jochebed to wife, but the summary already names her as his wife.
1CH 24:20 may refer to a different Amram or to his descendants; it is only a list of names.
